title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(情報工学科)
subtitle: Design Project III(Information And Computer Science)
educationalGoal: Based on the concrete knowledge of fundamental technology, students acquire problem-solving skills related to computer & information engineering. Students are also given opportunities to experience R&D activities related to concrete information technology and systems.Through this process, students cultivate advanced abilities in the area of problem setting, production process development, information gathering, communications, problem-solving ability in regional orientation, and making objective evaluations.
advice: The Internet society has expanded as a community centered on people and has developed significantly. The range of applications has expanded further to embrace robots, home appliances, various sensors, and other devices. This laboratory is researching a wide range of areas such as sensor network technology, image processing technology, robot technology, and electroencephalogram analysis in order to create a symbiotic space between humans and robots. The contents of research conducted in this laboratory are as follows: 1. Autonomous communication robot using vision and sensor information. 2. Wheelchair robot control system using EEG. 3. Examination and its evaluation of preprocessing method for individual identification in EEG. 4. Construction of information and communication infrastructure using blockchain technology. 5. Proposal on hybrid KleeFuzzer combining KLEE and Libbuzzer. 6. High-speed forensic technology against targeted cyber-attacks. 7. Automatic hydroponics system that generates recipes from the state of crops. In addition, I accept consultations on image processing systems, network systems, and web systems.
requiredKnowledge: Research guidance policy In this laboratory, seminars by students and faculty members are conducted once a week. Students are expected to set themes, summarize survey analysis results, discover social problems, and conduct annual events such as the writing academic papers and making conference presentations. Additionally, using multiple networked PCs, students explore robot technology, embedded system technology, cloud technology, network technology, image processing technology, etc.

activityGoals.body: Be able to set one-year achievement goals in relation to your chosen research.
Be able to set a specific production approach based on your set research concept.
Be able to use your acquired information engineering expertise to advance your design and analysis efforts.
Be able to cope with various problems that occur during the design and analysis process.
Be able to technically describe what you have accomplished in a convincing manner.

achievementLevels.standard: Be able to promote R&D activities smoothly according to the project plan (proposal) that you have created. In the results, it is desirable that students be able to announce concrete results that are based in scientific and technical reality.
